| description = To spawn [[Venril Sathir]], you need to give Venril Sathirs remains a [[Summoned: Firefly Globe]] which will spawn [[Spirit of Venril Sathir]]. You then give Spirit of Venril Sathir a [[Resurrection|Spell: Resurrection]] spawning Venril Sathir. Note that the Firefly Globe can only be summoned at night (7 p.m. - 4 a.m. game time), so you will likely need to cast the spell before forming your raid. 

Be careful not to cast [[Harmony]] / [[Pacify]] / [[Memory Blur]] on or near VSR, he will resist and aggro! The same is true for Enchanter's Alliance clicky. It will agro him. He cannot be mem-blurred. If you agro him, sit and die quickly!

Spawning note: A real Venril Sathir spawn will cause VSR to de-spawn, and VSR will respawn 24 Hours +/- (2 Hour Variance) after real VS dies. Otherwise the timers for the 2 mobs are entirely separate. VSR will continue to spawn every 24 Hours +/- (2 Hour Variance) each time it is killed or de-spawned until VS respawns.  If the spawned version of Venril Sathir is not killed within 20 minutes (verified 10/3/2023 on Blue), he will despawn naturally.

'''Listed spawn times (1-2 hours and 6-7 hours) in this article are not accurate for Green server at present.'''

EDIT: to add on to the above, VSR respawned after a VSR kill roughly 12-13 hours later 5/31/26
